comments.author: Shazaam
comments.body: It appears English is a requirement to pull this quest. I used about 20 QMP with no results. Once i used Germanic Translation notes I got the quest on the first try.

comments.author: Wystein
comments.body: I doubt English is a true requirement. I have done this quest and have never needed English to pull it. What you seen is that having the language GREATLY improves the odds of pulling a quest making it much easier.
